context: Mei comes home and tells Ren about her day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ただいま/驚く/引い/なろ/っぽい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ただいま。今日、すごく驚いたの。
lines.en: I'm home. I was so surprised today.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle animated delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おかえり。何に驚いたの?
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 道で、子供っぽい大人を見たの。
lines.en: On the street I saw a childish grown-up.
lines.style: amused woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、それで、引いちゃった?
lines.en: Huh, so were you put off?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ううん、むしろ自由になろうと思えたの。
lines.en: No, it made me want to become freer.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね、大人っぽくなくていいよ。
lines.en: Nice, you don't have to be all grown-up.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もっと素直になろうって、驚くほど思えた。
lines.en: I surprisingly felt I should become more honest.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ただいまの一言で、元気が出るね。
lines.en: Just hearing 'I'm home' cheers me up.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
